prompt:
You are writing short, natural English messages for a WhatsApp group chat.
Group members (use only these names as senders): Hetal P, Subhash ji.
Topic: everyday small talk, money lending, meeting up. Never mention deleting or removing any record,
entry, transfer or transaction. Use no digits, amounts, dates, month or weekday names, web
addresses, real bank, app or company names, and no instructions such as send, pay or transfer.
For each section below, write exactly as many messages as stated, in time order:
- between 10:30 am and 11:04 am: 6 messages
- between 11:04 am and 11:38 am: 6 messages
- between 11:38 am and 1:00 pm: 15 messages
Reply with only a JSON list and no other text: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAME", "text": "message"}, ...]
Each "time" must look like "h:mm am" or "h:mm pm". Each message must be one line.
text:
[
  {"time": "10:32 am", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Good morning Subhash ji, how are you doing today?"},
  {"time": "10:35 am", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Good morning. I am doing well, just having tea."},
  {"time": "10:39 am", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Nice. Are you free to talk about our cash help from earlier?"},
  {"time": "10:44 am", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Yes, I remembered that. Thanks again for helping me out."},
  {"time": "10:50 am", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "No problem at all, happy to support friends."},
  {"time": "11:01 am", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "I appreciate it so much. Let us catch up soon."},
  {"time": "11:08 am", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Should we meet near the market area today?"},
  {"time": "11:15 am", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "That sounds good to me. I have some errands there anyway."},
  {"time": "11:21 am", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Perfect. I can return what I borrowed from you last time as well."},
  {"time": "11:27 am", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Ah, there is no hurry for that, take your time."},
  {"time": "11:32 am", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "I insisted because I have it ready with me now."},
  {"time": "11:36 am", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Alright, if you are comfortable, we can settle it when we meet."},
  {"time": "11:42 am", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Shall we meet at the usual tea stall around noon?"},
  {"time": "11:46 am", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Yes, that spot is quiet and nice."},
  {"time": "11:51 am", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Great, I will leave my place shortly."},
  {"time": "11:57 am", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Sounds like a plan. I am finishing my breakfast now."},
  {"time": "12:04 pm", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Take your time, no rush at all."},
  {"time": "12:10 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "By the way, did you need any extra funds for your project?"},
  {"time": "12:15 pm", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "I think I have enough for now, but thank you for asking."},
  {"time": "12:22 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Always happy to assist if you ever need short term support."},
  {"time": "12:28 pm", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "You are very generous. I will let you know."},
  {"time": "12:33 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "I am starting towards the tea shop now."},
  {"time": "12:39 pm", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Me too, I am almost there."},
  {"time": "12:44 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "I reached and found a table near the corner."},
  {"time": "12:49 pm", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "I see you, coming inside now."},
  {"time": "12:54 pm", "sender": "Subhash ji", "text": "Excellent, ordering tea for both of us."},
  {"time": "12:58 pm", "sender": "Hetal P", "text": "Perfect, see you in a minute."}
]
